The Island Battlebox League, more commonly known as IBL is a professional battlebox league created to allow the best players from around the world to showcase their skills. The IBL is split into 2 leagues, A league, the top level of play for the best players in the world, and B league, a league for organizations to send their talented young prospects to develop more, comparable to a minor league. With 2, 6 team divisions the regular season is full of excitement, with the top 4 teams in each division making playoffs, where they are placed in a single elimination bracket to determine which team is the IBL champion. Games begin with the map selection process, with teams banning and selecting maps until 3 maps are chosen to be played. Whichever team wins a majority of the maps wins the game. Each map is best out of 5 giving ample chance for exciting plays, unique strategies, and a great viewing experience. Playoffs bring even more excitement, expanding the games to a total of 5 maps played. Whichever team can win 3 of these maps first advances and moves on in the playoffs while the other goes home.
